pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.2: tena kho pana samayena sāvatthiyaṃ aññatarassa pūgassa saṅghassa sacīvarabhattaṃ paṭiyattaṃ hoti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.4: athakho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū yena so pūgo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.9: bahū āvuso saṅghassa dāyakā bahū saṅghassa bhattā
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.10: ime tumhe nissāya tumhe sampassantā idha viharanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.11: tumhe ce imesaṃ na dassatha atha kocarahi imesaṃ dassati
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.13: athakho so pūgo chabbaggiyehi bhikkhūhi nippīḷiyamāno yathāpaṭiyattaṃ cīvaraṃ chabbaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ datvā saṅghaṃ bhattena parivisi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.14: ye te bhikkhū jānanti saṅghassa sacīvarabhattaṃ paṭiyattaṃ na ca jānanti chabbaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dinnanti te evamāhaṃsu
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.17: yathāpaṭiyattaṃ cīvaraṃ ayyā chabbaggiyā ayyānaṃ chabbaggiyānaṃ pariṇāmentīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.18: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.19: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū jānaṃ saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ puggalassa pariṇāmessantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.20: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave jānaṃ saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ puggalassa pariṇāmethāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.23: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā jānaṃ saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ puggalassa pariṇāmessatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.24: netaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.25: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.26.1: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ puggalassa pariṇāmeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:2.1.6: sāmaṃ vā jānāti aññe vā tassa ārocenti so vā āroceti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:2.1.12: dassāma karissāmāti vācā bhinnā hoti. puggalassa pariṇāmeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:2.2.1: pariṇate pariṇatasaññī puggalassa pariṇāmeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:2.2.2: pariṇate vematiko puggalassa pariṇāmeti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:2.2.4: saṅghassa pariṇataṃ aññassa saṅghassa vā cetiyassa vā pariṇāmeti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:2.2.5: cetiyassa pariṇataṃ aññassa cetiyassa vā saṅghassa vā puggalassa vā pariṇāmeti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:2.2.6: puggalassa pariṇataṃ aññassa puggalassa vā saṅghassa vā cetiyassa vā pariṇāmeti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:2.3.3: yattha tumhākaṃ deyyadhammo paribhogaṃ vā labheyya paṭisaṅkhāraṃ vā labheyya ciraṭṭhitiko vā assa yattha vā pana tumhākaṃ cittaṃ pasīdati tattha dethāti bhaṇati
